title: 第012章 氢弹炸化神劫第011章 外星修士降临
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
;;
华纪55年12月2日，上午，华夏基地上空。
第九道天雷与四枚氢弹的碰撞刚刚平息，劫云却没有消散。相反，云层中又凝聚起新的雷光——第十道。化神天劫本该只有九道，但张德华用氢弹炸天劫的疯狂举动，似乎触怒了天道。劫云不甘心，要降下第十道天雷，威力是第九道的十倍。
张德华躺在坑底，浑身焦黑，残破不堪。他的手边已经没有氢弹了。十枚天罚氢弹，前六枚用了六枚，最后一道用了四枚，全部耗尽。
“第十道……”他喃喃道，意识已经开始模糊。
天空中，第十道天雷正在凝聚。那不是雷龙，而是一把由雷电凝聚而成的巨剑，剑身长达千丈，剑锋直指张德华。巨剑散发出的威压，让方圆百里的空气都凝固了。
“首长！”陈铁军的声音从通讯器里传来，带着绝望，“快躲！”
躲？往哪躲？
张德华闭上眼睛。
然后，他笑了。
“系统，引爆所有剩余氢弹。”
“宿主，已无氢弹。”
“我说的是——基地储存库里的。”
“那会炸毁整个基地。”
“炸就炸吧。”张德华睁开眼睛，眼中燃烧着疯狂的光芒，“连天劫一起炸！”
系统沉默了一息。
“明白。引爆程序启动。”
华夏基地地下五百米深处，氢弹储存库。三十枚天罚氢弹整齐地排列在发射架上，每一枚的当量都是一亿吨。这是华夏联盟的全部战略储备，原本是为天狼星大军准备的。
此刻，它们的引爆程序同时启动。
倒计时：三、二、一。

三十枚氢弹同时爆炸。
大地剧烈震颤。华夏基地上空，地面裂开一道巨大的缝隙，炽白色的光芒从缝隙中喷涌而出，直冲云霄。那不是光，是毁灭本身。三十枚一亿吨当量的氢弹同时爆炸，释放出的能量相当于一颗小型恒星。爆炸中心的温度达到了十亿摄氏度，比太阳核心的温度还高一百倍。
冲击波向四面八方扩散，将方圆五百里的大地掀翻。山峰崩塌，河流倒灌，森林化为灰烬。天空中，劫云被冲击波撕裂，第十道天雷的巨剑在半空中崩碎。天道的力量，在三十枚氢弹面前，也不过如此。
爆炸的火球冲天而起，形成一个直径超过百里的蘑菇云。蘑菇云的顶端刺破了大气层，底部的冲击波将劫云的残余碎片一扫而空。
阳光重新洒下来。
而张德华，就在这毁灭的中心。
核爆中心，温度最高、压力最大的地方。这里的一切物质都被电离成等离子体，连原子都无法存在。张德华的身体在这股毁灭之力中被分解，皮肉、骨骼、内脏，全部化为最基本的粒子。
但丹田中的元婴，没有消散。
元婴在核爆中爆发出刺目的金光。它将周围所有的能量——氢弹的毁灭之力、天劫的残余之力、天地间的灵气——全部吸入体内。元婴的身体开始膨胀，一尺、两尺、一丈、十丈、百丈……
“碎婴成神！”
张德华的意识在核爆中心凝聚。他感觉自己的身体已经不存在了，但他的意识比任何时候都要清晰。他能“看到”方圆千里的每一粒尘埃，“听到”千里之外每一只蚂蚁的脚步声，“感受到”天地间每一缕灵气的流动。
元婴在吸收了核爆能量后，终于达到了临界点。
它炸开了。
不是毁灭，是新生。元婴化作无数金色的光点，光点在空中飞舞、重组、凝聚，逐渐形成一个全新的形态。那是一个高达千丈的金色虚影，与张德华的容貌一模一样。虚影周身环绕着浓郁的金光，光芒万丈，照亮了整片天地。
化神出窍。
张德华的元神，屹立在核爆中心的废墟之上。千丈高的金色虚影，俯视着脚下的苍茫大地。他的双眼如两轮太阳，他的呼吸如雷霆轰鸣，他的气息如海啸般席卷四方。
核爆的光芒渐渐消散。蘑菇云还在升腾，但已经被元神的金光冲淡了。
基地里，躲在地下掩体中的人们通过监控屏幕看到了这一幕。

On the morning of December 2, 1955, the sky above the Huaxia base.
The collision between the ninth thunderbolt and the four hydrogen bombs had just subsided, but the calamity cloud had not dissipated. On the contrary, a new thunder light condensed in the clouds - the tenth. There are supposed to be only nine heavenly tribulations in the transformation of gods, but Zhang Dehua's crazy move of using a hydrogen bomb to explode the tribulation seemed to offend the heavens. Jie Yun was unwilling to give in and wanted to drop the tenth thunder, which was ten times more powerful than the ninth.
Zhang Dehua lay at the bottom of the pit, his body charred and broken. He no longer had any hydrogen bombs on hand. Of the ten Heavenly Punishment hydrogen bombs, six of the first six were used, and four of the last one were used, all of which were exhausted.
"The tenth track..." He murmured, his consciousness beginning to blur.
In the sky, the tenth thunder is gathering. It was not a thunder dragon, but a giant sword made of thunder and lightning. The sword was a thousand feet long, and the blade was pointed directly at Zhang Dehua. The pressure emanating from the giant sword froze the air within a hundred miles.
"Chief!" Chen Tiejun's voice came from the communicator, with despair, "Hide quickly!"
Hide? Where to hide?
Zhang Dehua closed his eyes.
Then he laughed.
"System, detonate all remaining hydrogen bombs."
"Host, there is no more hydrogen bomb."
"I'm talking about - in the base storage."
"That would blow up the whole base."
"Blow it up." Zhang Dehua opened his eyes, with a crazy light burning in his eyes, "Blow it up with the catastrophe!"
The system was silent for a while.
"Understood. The detonation process is initiated."
Five hundred meters deep underground in the Huaxia base is the hydrogen bomb storage warehouse. Thirty heavenly punishment hydrogen bombs were neatly arranged on the launcher, each with a yield of 100 million tons. This is the entire strategic reserve of the Chinese Alliance, originally prepared for the Sirius army.
At this moment, their detonation procedures are started simultaneously.
Countdown: three, two, one.
Thirty hydrogen bombs exploded simultaneously.
The ground shook violently. Over the Huaxia base, a huge gap opened in the ground, and blazing white light spurted out from the gap and shot straight into the sky. That is not light, it is destruction itself. Thirty hydrogen bombs with a yield of 100 million tons exploded simultaneously, releasing an energy equivalent to that of a small star. The temperature at the center of the explosion reached one billion degrees Celsius, a hundred times hotter than the core of the sun.
The shock wave spread in all directions, overturning the ground within a radius of five hundred miles. Mountains collapsed, rivers poured in, and forests turned to ashes. In the sky, the calamity clouds were torn apart by the shock wave, and the giant sword of the tenth thunder shattered in mid-air. The power of heaven is no more than this in the face of thirty hydrogen bombs.
The explosive fireball soared into the sky, forming a mushroom cloud with a diameter of more than a hundred miles. The top of the mushroom cloud pierced the atmosphere, and the shock wave at the bottom swept away the remaining fragments of the cloud.
The sun shines again.
And Zhang Dehua is at the center of this destruction.
The center of a nuclear explosion is the place with the highest temperature and highest pressure. All matter here has been ionized into plasma, and even atoms cannot exist. Zhang Dehua's body was decomposed in this destructive force, and the skin, flesh, bones, and internal organs were all reduced to the most basic particles.
But the Nascent Soul in Dantian did not dissipate.
Nascent Soul erupted with dazzling golden light in the nuclear explosion. It absorbs all the surrounding energy - the destructive power of the hydrogen bomb, the residual power of the catastrophe, and the spiritual energy between heaven and earth - into the body. Nascent Soul's body began to expand, one foot, two feet, one foot, ten feet, one hundred feet...
"Broken baby becomes a god!"
Zhang Dehua's consciousness condensed at the center of the nuclear explosion. He felt like his body no longer existed, but his consciousness was clearer than ever. He can "see" every particle of dust thousands of miles away, "hear" the footsteps of every ant thousands of miles away, and "feel" the flow of every ray of spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
After absorbing the energy of the nuclear explosion, Nascent Soul finally reached the critical point.
It exploded.
Not destruction, but rebirth. The Nascent Soul turned into countless golden light spots, and the light spots were in the airFlying, reorganizing, condensing, and gradually forming a new form. It was a golden shadow that was thousands of feet tall, exactly the same as Zhang Dehua's appearance. The shadow was surrounded by a rich golden light, which illuminated the entire world.
Out of body.
Zhang Dehua’s spirit stands on the ruins of the nuclear blast center. The thousand-foot-tall golden shadow looked down at the vast land beneath its feet. His eyes are like two suns, his breath is like thunder, and his breath is like a tsunami that sweeps across all directions.
The light of the nuclear explosion gradually dissipated. The mushroom cloud is still rising, but it has been diluted by the golden light of the soul.
In the base, people hiding in underground bunkers saw this scene through surveillance screens.
